entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah. I need to start a return for a ProFit Jersey I bought a while back.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can you please provide the order number?

Thank you. I see the order here for one ProFit Jersey, delivered 77 days ago. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the item? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's a preference, I suppose. I ordered my usual size, but this jersey is just the wrong size for me. It's way too tight in the shoulders.
I understand. Sizing can definitely be tricky between different cuts. Let me just check the return eligibility for you. One moment.

Okay, thank you for waiting. According to our policy, your item is still unfortunately outside the 10-day return window. I've just initiated that return for you. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email on file now. You should receive it in the next few minutes.
That's great, thank you. Since I'm going to have to re-order it, and this has been a bit of an inconvenience, would it be possible to get a discount code for the exchange?

I'm glad I could process that return for you. While I can't provide a discount code for a sizing issue, I can definitely help you place the new order to ensure you get the perfect fit this time around. Would you like me to walk you through our detailed sizing chart?
I appreciate the offer, but a small percentage off would make me feel better about having to go through the exchange process. Even 10% would be helpful.

I certainly understand where you're coming from. My system simply doesn't allow for goodwill credits on size-related returns. However, the approved return means you will get a full refund for the jersey once we receive it, so you won't be out any money on the original item. Would you like me to go ahead and process a new order for the larger size now?
Alright, fair enough. No, I'll place the new order myself. Thanks for approving the return.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
